system_instruction: Act as an Expert Full-Stack Developer and UI/UX Designer to build a premium, high-trust law firm and attorney portfolio website.

project_details.target_audience: High-net-worth individuals, corporate clients, and individuals seeking elite legal representation.
project_details.inspiration: Top-tier, award-winning law firm websites of 2026. Think 'Editorial Luxury' combined with 'Tropical Modernism' or 'Architectural Restraint'—clean lines, confident use of white space, and subtle, purposeful motion.

tech_stack.framework: Next.js (App Router) OR SvelteKit (Optimized for Core Web Vitals and SEO)
tech_stack.graphics_and_animations: WebGL and Three.js (for a subtle, abstract 3D architectural element or gently rotating 'scales of justice' in the hero background), Framer Motion for scroll-based reveals.
tech_stack.state_management: Zustand (React) or Svelte Stores (for managing multi-step client intake forms)

architecture_and_features.description: A full-viewport, immersive landing area featuring oversized, confident serif typography. The background should include a subtle, slow-moving WebGL/Three.js abstract geometry (representing pillars of justice or stability) that reacts slightly to cursor movement.
A dedicated section establishing Experience, Expertise, Authoritativeness, and Trustworthiness. Features a high-quality, editorial-style portrait, bar admissions, published works, and credentials.

A card-based UI system displaying areas of practice (e.g., Corporate Law, Intellectual Property, Criminal Defense). Hovering over a card should trigger a smooth micro-animation revealing a brief description.
A visually structured layout highlighting past victories and client testimonials. Use minimal lines and dividers to separate data points (e.g., '$2.5M Settlement - Corporate Dispute').

A multi-step, ADA-accessible, and highly secure consultation booking form linked directly to 'contact@hsini.dev'. Must include progressive disclosure (asking simple questions first) to increase conversion rates.

colors.primary: #0f172a (Deep Slate/Navy for extreme professionalism and trust)
colors.secondary: #b45309 (Rich Gold/Bronze for luxury accents and CTAs)
colors.background: #f8fafc (Crisp, calming off-white to allow generous white space)
colors.text_secondary: #64748b (Muted tone for dates, disclaimers, and metadata)

typography.headings: Playfair Display or Cinzel (Elegant, oversized serif for authority and editorial feel)
typography.body: Inter or Lora (Highly legible, ADA-compliant fonts for heavy text consumption)

prompt_for_ai_builder: Generate the complete boilerplate and core UI components for a premium law firm portfolio at 'legal.hsini.dev'. Initialize a modern framework (Next.js/SvelteKit) using TypeScript and Tailwind CSS. Implement an 'Editorial Luxury' design system featuring deep navy tones, gold accents, and oversized serif typography. Build an immersive Hero section that incorporates a subtle Three.js/WebGL background animation (abstract pillars or geometric light). Develop modular components for 'Practice Areas', an E-E-A-T optimized 'Attorney Profile', and a structured 'Case Results' grid. Create a secure, multi-step 'Schedule Consultation' form that routes inquiries to 'contact@hsini.dev'. Ensure the entire site adheres to strict ADA accessibility guidelines (WCAG 2.2 AA), is highly responsive, and utilizes generous white space to convey confidence and prestige.

system_instruction: Act as an Expert Full-Stack Developer to build the Phase 2 backend, CMS, and advanced interactive features for a premium law firm portfolio.

project_details.target_audience: High-net-worth individuals requiring secure, confidential communication and seeking authoritative legal insights.

tech_stack.form_management: React Hook Form + Zod (for strict schema validation)

architecture_and_features.description: Complete the 'Schedule Consultation' component. Use Framer Motion to slide smoothly between Step 1 (Identity), Step 2 (Segment/Legal Issue), Step 3 (Details/Uploads), and Step 4 (Review). Implement Zod validation and a Next.js Server Action to sanitize inputs and securely email the payload to contact@hsini.dev.

Integrate a Headless CMS to power an 'Insights' page. Create a dynamic route (/insights/[slug]) that fetches and beautifully renders legal whitepapers, firm news, and case studies using the established editorial typography.
Build a custom, dark-themed interactive map (using Mapbox or WebGL) displaying the firm's global office locations. Clicking a location should reveal contact details and local managing partners.
Implement strict rate-limiting on the intake form to prevent abuse. Add a highly stylized, non-intrusive GDPR/CCPA cookie consent banner that matches the premium aesthetic.

Configure the repository workflows via GitHub. Set up the necessary environment variables and build scripts to ensure a flawless automated deployment pipeline directly to Vercel or a custom Ubuntu server environment.

design_system.guidelines: Maintain the existing 'Editorial Luxury' theme. Use deep navy (#0f172a) and gold (#b45309). Ensure all new form states (errors, loading spinners, success messages) look bespoke and high-end, avoiding default browser stylings.

prompt_for_ai_builder: Generate the Phase 2 full-stack components for 'legal.hsini.dev'. First, build a robust multi-step form engine using React Hook Form, Zod, and Framer Motion's AnimatePresence for the Consultation section. Write the Next.js Server Action to securely process this form. Second, set up the configuration and front-end dynamic routes for a Headless CMS (Sanity) to display an 'Insights & Whitepapers' blog grid and detail page. Third, build a 'Global Offices' section featuring a custom, dark-themed interactive map. Finally, implement a sophisticated GDPR cookie banner and provide the deployment configuration files for a seamless GitHub-based CI/CD pipeline.
